verdict.rationale: HeyGen's enterprise API page lists "zero data retention options," a first-party retention control, but it appears only as a single line on the enterprise tier, with no detail on how it is configured. Nothing in the pack documents user-facing deletion of videos, avatars or voice data. missing for 10: documented deletion controls or endpoints for videos/avatars/voice clones, configurable retention periods, availability outside the enterprise tier, in-depth docs on how zero retention works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
